title: DEFINE step 3 PRs 1-3, PR 5, PR 6, PR 7 and PR 8: intake markers, ledger update, resolvedBy grammar (PR 1); computeQuestions, questions verb and MCP tools (PR 2); draft-shape marker extension, DISCOVERY prototypes guidance and prompts (PR 3); D3 bite checks, ackable, --check exit 4 policy (PR 5); D4 closed-set and ownerRef findings, D5 concern catalogue, standards citation (PR 6); D6 consistency scans, probe seam, --litmus and rcf_define_litmus (PR 7); bundle refuse/override/skip, validate findings and NV-DL enforced (PR 8)
summary: Carry the ACs for PRs 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 of the DEFINE step 3 spec (2026-10-01). PR 1: statement-file markers in parseBriefFromFile ([kind] and (source: ...)), the brief add --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json wiring, the new ledger <name> update <id> subverb, and the resolvedBy closed pointer grammar validated by D2 (title-hit fallback dropped). PR 2: computeQuestions pure compute over readiness per persona; `rcf define questions` verb; three MCP tools (rcf_define_questions, rcf_define_readiness, rcf_define_ledger); the define-intent guidance file and the rcf_define_intent + rcf_define_intake prompts; two new managed-block rules. PR 3: parseInterfaceDraft extended to TAC.purpose and coreEntities[].description, shapes:draftSettled reports all three id forms (<tacId>:<name>, <tacId>, TAD.entity:<name>); the two new argument-free prompts rcf_define_draft_shapes and rcf_discover_prototype plus guidance/discovery-prototypes.md (REQ-188 + REQ-182 amended, ADR-4132). PR 5: the three D3 bite checks shapes:templateMarkers, shapes:entityJoin and shapes:pathsResolve on src/query/gates.js (parseInterfaceTemplate exported for validate); ackable(stage) companion to stagePolicy returning true for D3, D5, D6; readiness CLI --check shapes exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure and 0 when acked at the current hash; cli-readiness.js resolves candidate paths on disk and passes resolvedPaths in the stage context so gates stay pure (REQ-174 amended, US-17404, TAC-4122 and TAC-4123 amended, ADR-4131). Chain-first commits landed before the code in each PR. FBS stays notStarted until the CN axis mints Code Nodes against the ACs across the PRs. PR 1 tests ride TS-215; PR 2 tests ride TS-226; PR 3 tests ride TS-228 (renumbered from the cloud build's TS-227 after viewer PR 8 claimed TS-227 for US-18002); PR 5 tests ride TS-230 (next free when expecting the viewer PR 9 to land TS-229; brief predicted TS-230). PR 6 tests ride TS-231 and anchor CN-756, CN-757 and CN-758.
approach: PR 1: parseBriefFromFile parses a leading [kind] and a trailing (source: ...) marker; unknown kind raises LedgerError code 'usage' before any write. updateEntry patches named fields and re-runs validateLedger. parseResolvedBy / isResolvedByGrammar implement the closed pointer grammar. runIntakeScansOnDelta composes the three mechanical scans in src/intake/validate.js over new-plus-existing statements, attributing findings to the statement ids that participate. The CLI brief add wires --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json; the update subverb lives beside add in src/cli/ledger.js. D2's skeleton:resolvedBy drops the title-hit fallback and refuses a pointer outside the grammar with 'pointer does not resolve'. PR 2: src/query/questions.js exports computeQuestions(readiness, { tree, ledgers, profileText, persona }) folding readiness blockers into questions through a per-check template; src/cli/questions.js registers `rcf define questions` with --json, --persona, --stage, --limit; src/mcp/tools.js adds rcf_define_questions, rcf_define_readiness and rcf_define_ledger (thin wrapper over the ledger handler); guidance/define-intent.md and guidance/elicitation-playbook.md ship the loop content; guidance/manifest.json registers the new slug and the two argument-free prompts rcf_define_intent and rcf_define_intake; guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md adds the two new rules.
